title: Wishes and Regrets
description: Express wishes and regrets about life.
focus: By the end of today, you can communicate clearly about wanting things to be different using the day's 50 vocabulary items and grammar.

grammar.title: Wish + Past; Wish + would / could
grammar.titleArabic: التعبير عن التمني والندم (Wish + Past; Wish + would / could)
grammar.explanation: We use 'wish' (and 'If only') to express that we want situations to be different from reality: 1) 'Wish + Past Simple' expresses a wish about a present situation that we want to be different ('I wish I knew more about finance'; 'If only we were richer'). 2) 'Wish + Past Perfect' expresses regret about a past action or event ('I wish I had accepted that overseas transfer'; 'If only we had not signed the contract'). 3) 'Wish + would + base verb' expresses annoyance or a desire for someone or something to change their behavior ('I wish it would stop raining'; 'I wish you would listen'). Note: We do NOT use 'I wish I would' for ourselves; instead, we use 'I wish I could'. 4) 'Wish + could + base verb' expresses regret about personal lack of ability in the present or future ('I wish I could turn back the clock').
grammar.explanationArabic: نستخدم الفعل 'wish' (وكذلك العبارة 'If only') للتعبير عن رغبتنا في أن تكون الأمور مختلفة عما هي عليه في الواقع: 1) Wish + Past Simple: للتعبير عن تمني تغيير واقع حاضر غير مرغوب ('أتمنى لو كنت أعرف المزيد عن التمويل'; 'يا ليتنا كنا أغنى'). 2) Wish + Past Perfect (had + V3): للتعبير عن الندم على حدث وقع في الماضي ('أتمنى لو كنت قد قبلت العرض'; 'يا ليتنا لم نوقع العقد'). 3) Wish + would + المصدر: للتعبير عن التبرم والانزعاج ورغبة في أن يُغير شخص آخر سلوكه ('أتمنى لو تتوقف عن المقاطعة'). تنبيه: لا تقل 'I wish I would' لنفسك؛ بل قل 'I wish I could'. 4) Wish + could + المصدر: للتعبير عن العجز عن فعل شيء في الحاضر أو المستقبل ('أتمنى لو أستطيع إعادة عقارب الساعة للوراء').

structures.label: Present Wish · تمني تغيير الحاضر
structures.pattern: Subject + wish(es) + Subject + Past Simple (or were)
structures.explanation: Expresses that we want our present reality to be different.
structures.explanationArabic: يعبر عن الرغبة في تغيير أمر قائم في الحاضر.

structures.label: Past Regret · الندم على ماضٍ فات
structures.pattern: Subject + wish(es) + Subject + had + Past Participle (V3)
structures.explanation: Expresses sadness or remorse about something done or omitted in the past.
structures.explanationArabic: يعبر عن الحزن أو الأسف على تصرف تم أو فات في الماضي.

structures.label: Desire for Change / Annoyance · التذمر من سلوك (Would)
structures.pattern: Subject + wish(es) + Subject + would + Base Verb
structures.explanation: Used when annoyed by someone's persistent habit, asking for change.
structures.explanationArabic: يُستخدم لإظهار الانزعاج من عادة شخص والمطالبة بتغييرها.

structures.label: Ability / Opportunity Wish · تمني القدرة (Could)
structures.pattern: Subject + wish(es) + Subject + could + Base Verb
structures.explanation: Expresses regret about lacking the ability or permission to do something.
structures.explanationArabic: يعبر عن التمني لو كانت هناك قدرة أو ترخيص لفعل شيء.

examples.sentence: I wish I could turn back the clock and redress that critical mistake.
examples.translation: أتمنى لو أستطيع إعادة عقارب الساعة للوراء وتصحيح ذلك الخطأ الحاسم.

examples.sentence: If only we had recognized that golden opportunity missed, we would not endure bitter regret.
examples.translation: يا ليتنا أدركنا تلك الفرصة الذهبية المهدرة، لما عانينا من ندم مرير.

examples.sentence: She wishes her supervisor would stop dwelling on spilt milk and look for the silver lining.
examples.translation: تتمنى لو يتوقف مشرفها عن البكاء على اللبن المسكوب ويبحث عن الجانب المشرق.

examples.sentence: In hindsight, they wish they had not indulged in mere wishful thinking about the merger.
examples.translation: عند النظر للوراء بأثر رجعي، يتمنون لو لم ينغمسوا في مجرد تفكير بالتمني بشأن الاندماج.

commonMistakes.wrong: I wish I would have more free time to travel.
commonMistakes.right: I wish I had more free time to travel. (OR: I wish I could travel more)
commonMistakes.note: Do not use 'wish + would' for yourself; use Past Simple for present states, or 'could' for ability.
commonMistakes.noteArabic: لا تستخدم would مع الضمير I بعد wish؛ بل استخدم الماضي البسيط أو could.

commonMistakes.wrong: I wish I didn't go to that party last night; I caught a cold.
commonMistakes.right: I wish I hadn't gone to that party last night; I caught a cold.
commonMistakes.note: Use 'hadn't + past participle' to express regret about past events, not didn't.
commonMistakes.noteArabic: استخدم hadn't + التصريف الثالث للندم على ما حدث في الماضي وليس didn't.

commonUsage: Reflecting on missed chances: 'I wish I had accepted that scholarship.' (تُستخدم للتحسر والتأمل في الفرص الماضية.)
Expressing work frustration: 'I wish clients would respond to invoices on time.' (تُستخدم لإبداء الضيق من سلوكيات العمل.)
Longing for distant realities: 'She wishes she could pine less for home and thrive abroad.' (تُستخدم للتعبير عن الحنين والشوق.)

vocabulary.definition: The illusion that what one wishes for is actually true or will happen.
vocabulary.example: Hoping the market will double overnight is pure wishful thinking.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: الرجاء بأن السوق سيتضاعف بين عشية وضحاها هو مجرد تفكير بالتمني.

vocabulary.definition: Used to express a strong wish, yearning, or deep regret.
vocabulary.example: If only I had listened to my mentor's advice about diversified investing.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: يا ليتني استمعت لنصيحة مرشدي بشأن التنويع في الاستثمار.

vocabulary.definition: Understanding the nature of an event only after it has actually happened.
vocabulary.example: In hindsight, selling the family house during the recession was a tactical error.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: عند النظر للوراء بأثر رجعي، كان بيع منزل العائلة أثناء الركود خطأً تكتيكياً.

vocabulary.definition: With the perception and clarity that comes from looking back at the past.
vocabulary.example: With hindsight, we wish we had retained the patent rights instead of licensing them.
vocabulary.translation: في ضوء ما تبين لاحقاً / بحكمة ما بعد التجربة
vocabulary.exampleArabic: في ضوء ما تبين لاحقاً، نتمنى لو احتفظنا بحقوق براءة الاختراع بدلاً من ترخيصها.

vocabulary.definition: To bitterly regret a specific moment, decision, or past action.
vocabulary.example: He will rue the day he signed that predatory non-disclosure agreement.
vocabulary.translation: يلعن اليوم الذي فعل فيه ذلك / يندم أشد الندم
vocabulary.exampleArabic: سيندم أشد الندم ويلعن اليوم الذي وقع فيه اتفاقية عدم الإفصاح الجائرة تلك.

vocabulary.definition: To express deep sorrow, grief, or passionate regret about something.
vocabulary.example: Old scholars lament the loss of handwritten manuscript literacy in modern youth.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: يتحسر العلماء القدامى على ضياع مهارة قراءة المخطوطات اليدوية بين شباب العصر.

vocabulary.definition: Filled with deep, painful regret and guilt for past wrongs committed.
vocabulary.example: The remorseful witness apologized tearfully to the falsely accused defendant.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: اعتذر الشاهد النادم والباكي للمدعى عليه المتهم ظلماً.

vocabulary.definition: Sudden, sharp twinges of guilt, regret, or moral shame.
vocabulary.example: He felt sharp pangs of conscience after concealing the financial audit mistake.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: شعر بوخزات ضمير حادة بعد إخفاء خطأ التدقيق المالي.

vocabulary.definition: An intense, painful longing or persistent craving for someone or something.
vocabulary.example: She harbored an aching desire to return to her homeland and see the olive groves.
vocabulary.translation: شوق مؤلم / رغبة ملحة تعتصر القلب
vocabulary.exampleArabic: أضمرت في قلبها شوقاً مؤلماً للعودة إلى وطنها ورؤية بساتين الزيتون.

vocabulary.definition: A yearning desire, often accompanied by sadness or wistful distance.
vocabulary.example: His eyes reflected a quiet longing for the simpler peaceful days of his youth.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: عكست عيناه حنيناً هادئاً للأيام الأبسط والأكثر سكينة في شبابه.

vocabulary.definition: Having or showing a feeling of vague or regretful longing.
vocabulary.example: She cast a wistful glance at the ocean horizon as the departing ship sailed away.
vocabulary.translation: مليء بالحنين والأسى الهادئ / شارد بحسرة
vocabulary.exampleArabic: ألقت نظرة تفيض بالحنين والأسى الهادئ على أفق المحيط مع إبحار السفينة المغادرة.

vocabulary.definition: A sentimental yearning for the happiness felt in a former place or time.
vocabulary.example: The scent of wild lavender stirred nostalgic longing for her grandmother's garden.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: أثارت رائحة اللافندر البري شوقاً نوستالجياً لحديقة جدتها.

vocabulary.definition: To indulge in a series of pleasant, visionary, but unrealizable thoughts.
vocabulary.example: I wish I did not daydream during corporate accounting presentations.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: أتمنى لو لم أسرح بأحلام اليقظة أثناء العروض التقديمية للمحاسبة المؤسسية.

vocabulary.definition: Something pleasant that is promised or wished for but very unlikely to happen.
vocabulary.example: Their proposal for automated zero-cost public healthcare proved to be pie in the sky.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: أثبت مقترحهم لرعاية صحية عامة مؤتمتة ومجانية تماماً أنه مجرد أمانٍ خيالية مستحيلة.
collocations: dismiss as pie in the sky
sound like pie in the sky

vocabulary.definition: An unattainable, fantastic, or hopeless plan or hope.
vocabulary.example: Building a lunar colony by next year is a pure engineering pipe dream.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: بناء مستعمرة قمرية بحلول العام القادم هو مجرد حلم هندسي واهم مستحيل.
collocations: turn out to be a pipe dream

vocabulary.definition: A daydream, speculative vision, or visionary project that has no firm foundation.
vocabulary.example: Stop building castles in the air and draft a realistic, verifiable business budget.
vocabulary.translation: قصور في الرمال / أوهام لا أساس لها
vocabulary.exampleArabic: توقف عن بناء قصور في الهواء وضع ميزانية عمل واقعية وقابلة للتحقق.

vocabulary.definition: An opportunity that was allowed to slip away unutilized.
vocabulary.example: Failing to purchase shares before the technological revolution was a bitterly lost chance.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: كان الإخفاق في شراء الأسهم قبل الثورة التكنولوجية فرصة ضائعة بمرارة.

vocabulary.definition: A uniquely favorable, rare occasion that was neglected or overlooked.
vocabulary.example: Rejecting that university scholarship was a golden opportunity missed.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: كان رفض تلك المنحة الجامعية فرصة ذهبية مهدرة لن تتكرر.

vocabulary.definition: A reconsideration of an earlier decision or opinion, accompanied by doubt.
vocabulary.example: I wish I had listened to my second thoughts before signing the apartment lease.
vocabulary.translation: شكوك وتفكير متأخر / تردد بعد الاتفاق
vocabulary.exampleArabic: أتمنى لو استمعت لشكوكي وتفكيري المتأخر قبل توقيع عقد إيجار الشقة.

vocabulary.definition: A reversal of one's opinions, feelings, intentions, or loyalties.
vocabulary.example: He had a sudden change of heart and decided to forgive his estranged brother.
vocabulary.translation: تبدل في المشاعر والموقف / انقلاب في الرأي
vocabulary.exampleArabic: حدث له تبدل مفاجئ في المشاعر والموقف وقرر أن يصفح عن شقيقه المبتعد.

vocabulary.definition: A harsh, agonizing feeling of sorrow for what might have been done.
vocabulary.example: She felt bitter regret that she had never reconciled with her grandfather before his death.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: شعرت بندم مرير ومؤلم لكونها لم تتصالح مع جدها قبل وفاته.

vocabulary.definition: An intense, gnawing psychological pain arising from moral fault.
vocabulary.example: The convicted driver showed deep remorse throughout the emotional courtroom hearing.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: أظهر السائق المدان ندماً عميقاً يعتصر الفؤاد طوال جلسة المحكمة المؤثرة.

vocabulary.definition: A profound yearning or longing that has never been satisfied.
vocabulary.example: His unfulfilled desire to publish a historical novel lingered into his retirement years.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: ظلت رغبته الدفينة في نشر رواية تاريخية تراوده حتى سنوات تقاعده.

vocabulary.definition: A wish or hope that remains completely unanswered, unreturned, or ignored.
vocabulary.example: Her long letters seemed like an unrequited wish cast into an empty canyon.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: بدت رسائلها الطويلة كأنها أمنية بلا صدى أُلقيت في وادٍ سحيق فارغ.

vocabulary.definition: Reflective contemplation about hypothetical alternate outcomes of one's past.
vocabulary.example: It is agonizing to constantly brood over what might have been instead of moving forward.
vocabulary.translation: ما كان يمكن أن يكون / لو جرت الأمور بشكل آخر
vocabulary.exampleArabic: من المؤلم والمضني أن يظل المرء ينوح على ما كان يمكن أن يكون بدلاً من المضي قدماً.

vocabulary.definition: An error, misfortune, or damage that has occurred and cannot be altered.
vocabulary.example: The lost grant money is spilt milk; we must look for fresh private benefactors.
vocabulary.translation: لبن مسكوب / ضرر فات أوانه ولا سبيل لإصلاحه
vocabulary.exampleArabic: أموال المنحة المفقودة هي لبن مسكوب؛ يجب علينا البحث عن ممولين خواص جدد.

vocabulary.definition: To waste time and emotional energy mourning past mistakes that cannot be undone.
vocabulary.example: Do not cry over spilt milk; focus your intelligence on the upcoming quarterly rollout.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: لا تبكِ على اللبن المسكوب؛ بل ركز ذكاءك على إطلاق الربع القادم.
collocations: no use crying over spilt milk
refuse to cry over spilt milk

vocabulary.definition: To return to the past or recreate bygone conditions.
vocabulary.example: If only I could turn back the clock and redo that critical investor pitch.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: يا ليتني أستطيع إعادة عقارب الساعة للوراء وإعادة ذلك العرض الحاسم للمستثمرين.

vocabulary.definition: A minor reward given to someone who fails to win the primary contest.
vocabulary.example: The runner-up certificate felt like an empty consolation prize after losing the championship.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: بدت شهادة الوصيف وكأنها مجرد جائزة ترضية فارغة بعد خسارة البطولة.

vocabulary.definition: Sympathy, consolation, or reassurance that offers little or no genuine comfort.
vocabulary.example: Knowing that other competitors also failed was cold comfort to the bankrupted inventor.
vocabulary.translation: عزاء بارد لا يسمن ولا يغني من جوع
vocabulary.exampleArabic: كانت معرفة أن المنافسين الآخرين قد فشلوا أيضاً مجرد عزاء بارد للمخترع المفلس.

vocabulary.definition: A comforting or hopeful aspect present within an otherwise bleak or miserable situation.
vocabulary.example: The silver lining of the factory closure was that it prompted her to start her own firm.
vocabulary.translation: الجانب الإيجابي المشرق في قلب المحنة
vocabulary.exampleArabic: كان الجانب الإيجابي المشرق لإغلاق المصنع أنه دفعها لتأسيس شركتها الخاصة.
collocations: every cloud has a silver lining

vocabulary.definition: To compensate someone for a grievance or undo the harm caused by one's fault.
vocabulary.example: I wish I could make amends to those I wronged during my arrogant early twenties.
vocabulary.translation: يكفّر عن خطئه / يصلح ما أفسده
vocabulary.exampleArabic: أتمنى لو أستطيع التكفير عن أخطائي لمن أسأت إليهم أثناء غرور أوائل عشرينياتي.

vocabulary.definition: To set right, remedy, or rectify an unfair or erroneous past deed.
vocabulary.example: The municipal authority took immediate measures to redress a mistake in property tax rates.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: اتخذت سلطة البلدية تدابير فورية لتصحيح خطأ في أسعار ضريبة العقارات.

vocabulary.definition: To yearn intensely and persistently for someone or something, often while wasting away.
vocabulary.example: She pined for the majestic mountains of her childhood throughout her stay in the desert city.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: حنت وتلهفت بشوق يضني القلب لجبال طفولتها الشامخة طوال إقامتها بالمدينة الصحراوية.

vocabulary.definition: To feel or express deep grief for the demise or passing of someone or something treasured.
vocabulary.example: The artistic community continues to mourn the loss of the brilliant playwright.
vocabulary.translation: ينعى الفقد / ينوح على خسارة عزيزة
vocabulary.exampleArabic: يواصل المجتمع الفني نعي الفقد والحداد على رحيل الكاتب المسرحي العبقري.

vocabulary.definition: To express deep discontent, sorrow, or regret over an unfavorable condition.
vocabulary.example: Critics bemoan the decline of classical literature in secondary school curricula.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: ينعى النقاد بمرارة تراجع الأدب الكلاسيكي في مناهج المدارس الثانوية.

vocabulary.definition: Reproach or blame directed against oneself for personal failures.
vocabulary.example: He spent years consumed by bitter self-reproach after causing the family business rupture.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: أمضى سنوات ينهشه لوم النفس وتأنيب الذات بعد تسببه في انهيار أعمال العائلة.

vocabulary.definition: A feeling of guilt, especially when intentionally induced by someone else.
vocabulary.example: Do not let your relatives lay a guilt trip on you for prioritizing your career.
vocabulary.translation: عقدة ذنب / ابتزاز عاطفي بتأنيب الضمير
vocabulary.exampleArabic: لا تدع أقاربك يفرضون عليك عقدة ذنب لكونك تعطي الأولوية لمسارك المهني.

vocabulary.definition: A profound feeling of deep sorrow, sadness, or reluctance.
vocabulary.example: With a heavy heart, the headmaster announced the permanent closure of the rural school.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: بقلب مثقل بالأسى، أعلن مدير المدرسة الإغلاق النهائي للمدرسة الريفية.

vocabulary.definition: Continually troubled, disturbed, or plagued by painful memories of past deeds.
vocabulary.example: The veteran explorer was haunted by past mistakes committed in the arctic expedition.
vocabulary.translation: تطارده أشباح الماضي / أسير لذكرياته الأليمة
vocabulary.exampleArabic: كان المستكشف المخضرم مطارداً بأشباح أخطاء الماضي التي وقعت في الحملة القطبية.

vocabulary.definition: To reflect on previous choices with sorrow, wishing they had been different.
vocabulary.example: I wish I did not look back with regret on my creative decisions during university.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: أتمنى لو لم أنظر للوراء بأسف وندم على قراراتي الإبداعية أثناء دراستي الجامعية.

vocabulary.definition: A disappointment or disillusionment following high hopes.
vocabulary.example: The much-anticipated technological sequel was a colossal letdown to gamers.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: كان الجزء الثاني المرتقب للعبة خيبة أمل كبرى للاعبين.

vocabulary.definition: A standard, hope, or goal that was not achieved or satisfied.
vocabulary.example: Unmet expectations in early marriage often lead to preventable friction.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: غالباً ما تؤدي التوقعات غير المتحققة في بداية الزواج إلى خلافات كان يمكن تفاديها.

vocabulary.definition: A painful, abrupt realization of the unpleasant truth of a situation.
vocabulary.example: Graduating into an economic depression was a harsh awakening for young scholars.
vocabulary.translation: يقظة قاسية على الواقع / صدمة الحقيقة المرة
vocabulary.exampleArabic: كان التخرج في خضم ركود اقتصادي يقظة قاسية وصدمة مريرة للباحثين الشباب.

vocabulary.definition: A deeply cherished hope or ambition that has been completely destroyed.
vocabulary.example: His shattered dream of becoming an Olympic gymnast left him directionless for months.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: تركه حلمه المحطم بأن يصبح بطلاً أولمبياً في الجمباز تائهاً لعدة أشهر.

vocabulary.definition: An optimism or confidence that has gradually weakened and nearly vanished.
vocabulary.example: Faded hopes for an early diplomatic breakthrough prompted families to flee.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: دفعت الآمال المتلاشية في تحقيق اختراق دبلوماسي مبكر العائلات إلى الفرار.

vocabulary.definition: A perfect standard or model that cannot possibly be attained in real life.
vocabulary.example: Striving for an unreachable ideal of physical flawlessness fuels chronic anxiety.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: يغذي السعي وراء نموذج مثالي مستحيل المنال للكمال الجسدي القلق المزمن.

vocabulary.definition: A persistent hope that has virtually no chance of being fulfilled.
vocabulary.example: Searching the wreckage after three weeks was a forlorn hope for the rescue squad.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: كان البحث في الحطام بعد ثلاثة أسابيع رجاءً يائساً وأملاً شبه مستحيل لفرقة الإنقاذ.

vocabulary.definition: To feel an intense longing, craving, or deep affection for something absent.
vocabulary.example: Prisoners yearning for freedom looked out at the birds beyond the watchtower wire.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: نظر السجناء التائقون إلى الحرية للطيور المحلقة خلف أسلاك برج المراقبة.

vocabulary.definition: To emit a deep, audible breath expressing sadness, sorrow, or past failure.
vocabulary.example: The retired captain sighed with regret as he locked the vessel logbook forever.
vocabulary.exampleArabic: تنهد القبطان المتقاعد بحسرة وأسف وهو يغلق سجل السفينة إلى الأبد.

conversations.title: Reflecting on a Lost Venture
conversations.setting: Two retired business partners drink coffee on a veranda, reminiscing about their early tech enterprise.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Do you ever find yourself looking back with regret on that patent we sold in our twenties, Elena?

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: With hindsight, I realize it was a golden opportunity missed, but it is spilt milk now.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: I wish we had retained fifty percent equity! If only we had not been so easily intimidated.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Marcus, we cannot turn back the clock. Brooding over what might have been will only bring bitter regret.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: I know. When I see their global valuation today, I still sigh with regret.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Remember the silver lining: that seed payout allowed you to buy your vineyard debt-free.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: That is true. Aching desire for past riches is mere wishful thinking anyway.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Exactly. Let us toast to the lessons we learned and the rich memories we made!

conversations.title: Atoning for an Old Misunderstanding
conversations.titleArabic: التكفير عن سوء تفاهم قديم بين صديقين
conversations.setting: An older professional meets an estranged former colleague at a quiet library garden.

lines.speaker: Julian
lines.text: I invited you here because I felt sharp pangs of conscience about our boardroom dispute years ago.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: That fallout was painful; I felt deep remorse over the harsh words I traded back then.

lines.speaker: Julian
lines.text: I had second thoughts immediately, and I have felt truly remorseful ever since.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: I carried a heavy heart too, and no professional consolation prize could replace our lost partnership.

lines.speaker: Julian
lines.text: I wish I could make amends for taking that unfair credit on our joint publication.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: I do not lament our shared history anymore; knowing that you wish to redress a mistake brings genuine peace of mind.

lines.speaker: Julian
lines.text: I was haunted by the past and feared you would reject my invitation.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Better late than never, Julian; let us move forward as trusted friends.

conversations.title: Chasing Illusions vs Facing Reality
conversations.setting: A senior mentor counsels a frustrated apprentice who dreams of overnight musical fame.

lines.speaker: Apprentice
lines.text: I wish recording studios would answer my demo tapes; waiting is pure agony!

lines.speaker: Mentor
lines.text: Relying on sudden viral discovery is building castles in the air, my friend.

lines.speaker: Apprentice
lines.text: Is pursuing international stardom really just a pipe dream?

lines.speaker: Mentor
lines.text: It becomes a pie in the sky when you ignore daily deliberate craft practice.

lines.speaker: Apprentice
lines.text: I feel such an unfulfilled desire whenever I see packed amphitheaters.

lines.speaker: Mentor
lines.text: Do not let unmet expectations poison your creative spirit or invite a harsh awakening.

lines.speaker: Apprentice
lines.text: I understand. I should stop daydreaming and dedicate six hours daily to piano scales.

lines.speaker: Mentor
lines.text: Grounded work will transform those wistful daydreams into durable reality.

paragraphs.title: The Emotional Weight of Unresolved Regrets
paragraphs.text: Human memory is often shadowed by nostalgic longing and painful memories of what might have been. When individuals look back with regret upon a lost chance or golden opportunity missed, bitter regret can fester into crippling self-reproach. Many people rue the day they allowed fear to dictate their choices, living burdened with a heavy heart and haunted by the past. Yet philosophers wisely remind us that mourning over spilt milk will never turn back the clock. The true antidote to lingering sorrow is not to bemoan past errors, but to sincerely make amends and seek the silver lining in every trial.

paragraphs.title: From Wishful Daydreams to Grounded Reality
paragraphs.titleArabic: من أحلام اليقظة الوردية إلى الواقع الصلب
paragraphs.text: It is delightfully easy to build a castle in the air and daydream about instant triumphs, but unanchored fantasies often collapse into a pipe dream or pie in the sky. When young entrepreneurs fall prey to mere wishful thinking, encountering an inevitable market downturn feels like a brutal harsh awakening. Experiencing a bitter letdown or suffering from an unfulfilled desire is an unavoidable part of personal development. Rather than chasing an unreachable ideal or clinging to a forlorn hope, mature achievers channel their aching desire into rigorous discipline, refusing to wallow in scanted cold comfort.

paragraphs.title: Healing the Wounds of Conscience and Past Wrongs
paragraphs.titleArabic: شفاء جراح الضمير والتكفير عن زلات الماضي
paragraphs.text: When an ethical transgression damages a sacred relationship, genuine remorseful reflection is the only path toward restoration. Those who endure painful pangs of conscience understand that trying to bury a fault under defensive pride only deepens moral guilt. A sincere person will not allow an estranged friend to pine for recognition or mourn the loss of friendship alone. Instead of allowing sorrow to linger as an unrequited wish, taking prompt action to redress a mistake and vocalize deep remorse liberates both the offender and the wronged party, restoring enduring dignity to both souls.
